remarks: Completely Updated and Well Maintained Tri-level 3 Bedroom/3.5 Bath Townhouse Built in 2007 with Hardwood Floors Throughout. The Kitchen Features Granite Counter-tops, Stainless Steel Appliances, Gas Range. Bright and Sunny Dinning Room/ Living Room and a Half Bath Complete This Level. Upstairs is the Primary Bedroom with a Full Bath Bath, a Bedroom, Full Bath and Laundry. The Finished Third Floor with a Full Bath can also be used as a Primary Bedroom Suite, Family room, Home Office or Guest Bedroom. Additional Features Include an Attached 2-car Garage with Extra Room for Storage, High Efficiency Gas Heat and Central Air. Convenient to I-95, Route 7, SoNo Collection and Restaurants. Please Schedule your Private Viewing Before It is Gone!!!!
